newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee edges up vs dlr in uneventful trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee edges up vs dlr in uneventful trade.

text.p: *The dollar closed at 35.65/66 rupees on Monday against the dollar, slightly up from the opening quote of 35.67/68, dealers said.
*They said the rupee moved up to 35.64 at one point but slipped to close at 35.65/66 level.
*"Supply (of dollars) continues to be normal but there is no buying interest," one dealer lamented. He called the day's trade lacklusture. "It has been like this for the whole of August."
*Dollar forward premia was steady and showed a slight easing towards the close at 10.75 percent annualised for six-month forward, one dealer said.
